action: Students: do not share or reproduce the circulating file, as UFLA advises, and follow UFLA's official channels for updates.
date_note: Date is the publication day of UFLA's own clarification note (17 November 2026); the note does not say when the list was released.
exec: A Brazilian federal university is investigating the release of student academic data; it says this is separate from its system outage.
plain: The Federal University of Lavras says it is investigating the release of a list of students' academic information and trying to find where it came from. It says this is separate from the outage of its systems.

sources.name: UFLA, Nota de esclarecimento sobre divulgação de dados pessoais
UFLA, Comunicado sobre a indisponibilidade dos sistemas institucionais

summary: UFLA said on 17 November it is investigating the release of a list of students' academic information, including names, courses and grade averages. Its information security and incident response teams and its data protection officer are working to identify the source, and notifying the ANPD and affected people is being assessed. UFLA says this is unrelated to its system outage, which its IT directorate says was not caused by a cyberattack.
title: UFLA investigates release of students' academic data, separate from system outage

validation.note: Follow-up 22 Nov: UFLA's own clarification note (17 Nov) and systems notice (18 Nov, updated 18 Nov 15:20) read on ufla.br, plus Rádio Itatiaia (21 Nov). UFLA's note gives no number of students and no cause. The systems notice says no restoration forecast as of 18 Nov; no later UFLA note was found on its news index.
